phases: Fill the mold with loose soil mix
Swing handle and yoke upright together
Flip the latch claw open onto its stop
Pull the handle over onto the stop (pressing)
Locked over centre: brick pressed to 4 in
Drop the latch claw onto the catch bar
Tilt handle and yoke back onto the eject roller
Push the handle down to eject the brick
Lift the brick off and stack it
Raise the handle: piston drops for the next fill
